installAgentPrompt: HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) kompiitara kana irratti qopheessi. HAX CLI `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`n dhaabi, achiis dandeettiiwwan eejentii isaa `hax skills install --all`n dhaabi. Marsariitii `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`n uumi, `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`n jalqabi, teessoo inni maxxansus natti himi. Osoo homaa hin jijjiirin dura AGENTS.md marsariitichaa fi https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw dubbisi.
